summary: Iteration 12: Interview Prep Coach (questions + mock interview), 27-program re-verification, privacy contact email, light regression. Backend 10/10 pytest pass (real Claude calls: questions ~25s, chat ~5-10s). Frontend: Prep button gating by status (saved -> hidden, interviewed -> shown), dialog, 8 cached questions with expandable tip + sample answer, mock reset + answer/feedback flow, privacy mailto, BBI detail (8-35 years, accuracy note 'checked 2026-11-06') all verified. No functional bugs found.

minor.issue: Only '**' is stripped; single-asterisk markdown italics still come through (e.g. 'try explaining *why* the library matters') and display as literal asterisks in the transcript.
The backend doesn't check that the saved job's status is 'interviewed'/'hired'. The gate exists only in the UI, so any saved job can use the AI endpoints by calling the API directly.
No max length on 'message', and no limit on how many turns a session can have after 'complete'. Long input or extra turns run up LLM cost.

integration_issues.issue: restart() waits for the DELETE before clearing the session, so the old transcript and the enabled Send button stay visible during the delete. restart() then calls send(null) with a stale closure that still holds the old session_id (the backend copes by creating a new session). If the user sends an answer in that gap, it goes to the deleted session and can recreate it. Fix: setSession(null) and lock the input before awaiting the delete, and pass session_id null explicitly.

issues: The user's answer bubble appears only after the LLM responds (not added optimistically). Fine, but it would feel quicker if added right away.
The accuracy note text is very small and low-contrast on the yellow card.

action_items: Optional: strip single '*' markdown from mock-interview replies (or render markdown)
Optional: enforce the interviewed/hired status gate on the backend interview-prep endpoints
Optional: fix the restart race in InterviewPrepDialog (clear the session and disable input before awaiting DELETE; send with session_id null)
critical_code_review_comments: The backend interview endpoints have no status gate (UI-only).
InterviewPrepDialog.restart uses a stale session closure in send(null).
DELETE /interview-prep/sessions/{id} always returns ok, even when no session matches (acceptable).
